rule: a field counts as an English name when its name or alias says English (eng / english / אנגל / לועז)
verdict: No usable English field: education (769 schools, 768 kindergartens, 624 daycares), community (553) and synagogues (568) have no English name field; culture (745) has NAME_ENG (alias 'שם באנגלית') but it is empty in every record city-wide. Nothing was taken from the city's GIS.
